name: Highline Trail
why: Along a ledge cut into the Garden Wall above the Going-to-the-Sun Road, through wildflowers and mountain goats, to the 1914 Granite Park Chalet.
book: A park shuttle ticket is needed for long hikes that start at Logan Pass, Highline included (recreation.gov); the shuttle also brings you back from The Loop. Going-to-the-Sun Road vehicle reservation in summer. Granite Park Chalet beds by lottery.
water: None until Granite Park Chalet (buy or filter): carry 3 litres.
dangers: The first stretch is a narrow ledge above a 30 m drop with a hand cable.
Snow on the ledge until mid-July: the trail opens late.
